# Agent skills

> SKILL.md playbooks. One job per skill, loaded on demand.
> AGENTS.md is the always-on runbook for this library.

Paste the repo. Read AGENTS.md. Load one skill. Do not ingest the library.

Install: `npx skills add Thingscorp/skills --all`
List without install: `npx skills add Thingscorp/skills --list -y`
Catalog: https://skills.sh/Thingscorp/skills

## Start

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/AGENTS.md): agent runbook
- [README.md](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/README.md): install + library table
- [docs/QUICKSTART.md](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): human start
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): pointer at AGENTS.md
- [skills.sh catalog](https://skills.sh/Thingscorp/skills): public listing

## Skills

- [learn-codebase](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/learn-codebase/SKILL.md): learn an unfamiliar repo from disk
- [grill-execute-clear](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/grill-execute-clear/SKILL.md): grill design, then build in this session
- [to-spec](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/to-spec/SKILL.md): destination spec and vertical tickets
- [unix-compound](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/unix-compound/SKILL.md): split a domain into one-thing modules
- [ralph-plan](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/ralph-plan/SKILL.md): plan a ticket queue
- [ralph-loop](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/ralph-loop/SKILL.md): run a ticket queue across sessions
- [ralph-swarm](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/ralph-swarm/SKILL.md): run independent ticket queues in parallel
- [quality-loop](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/quality-loop/SKILL.md): inventory features from code, then test
- [review](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/review/SKILL.md): P0/P1/P2 read; decision-grade findings become ADRs
- [handoff](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/handoff/SKILL.md): choose the phase-boundary move
- [compact](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/compact/SKILL.md): shrink this session with a one-line focus
- [kill-context-bloat](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/kill-context-bloat/SKILL.md): shrink starting context
- [session-hygiene](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/session-hygiene/SKILL.md): keep a session clean
- [claude-code-habits](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/claude-code-habits/SKILL.md): Claude Code names for session-hygiene
- [cursor-habits](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/cursor-habits/SKILL.md): Cursor names for session-hygiene
- [codex-habits](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/codex-habits/SKILL.md): Codex names for session-hygiene
- [copilot-habits](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/copilot-habits/SKILL.md): Copilot CLI names for session-hygiene
- [gemini-cli-habits](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/gemini-cli-habits/SKILL.md): Gemini CLI names for session-hygiene
- [steering-push-vs-point](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/steering-push-vs-point/SKILL.md): always-on rules vs on-demand skills
